shelters.name: Wisconsin Humane Society
shelters.description: Founded in 1879, largest shelter in Wisconsin. Operates campuses in 6 counties. Serves 40,000+ animals annually and matches 13,000+ with new families yearly. No-kill policy.

shelters.name: Dane County Humane Society
shelters.description: Provides refuge, healing and new beginnings to over 9,000 companion animals, exotic species, farm animals and injured wildlife.

shelters.name: HAWS - Humane Animal Welfare Society
shelters.description: Celebrating 60th Anniversary since 1965. Leads community in animal welfare and assures sanctuary for animals in need in Waukesha County.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Southern Wisconsin
shelters.description: Private nonprofit 501(c)(3). Provides shelter and humane care to lost and homeless pets. Offers low-cost spay/neuter and vaccine/wellness services.

shelters.name: Wisconsin Humane Society - Green Bay
shelters.description: Wisconsin Humane Society campus serving Brown County and the Green Bay area.

shelters.name: Coulee Region Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving the La Crosse and Coulee Region area.

shelters.name: Sheboygan County Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving Sheboygan County in eastern Wisconsin.

shelters.name: Fox Valley Humane Association
shelters.description: Humane society serving the Fox Valley and Appleton area.

shelters.name: Lakeland Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Animal shelter serving Walworth County and surrounding areas.

shelters.name: Washington County Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving Washington County in southeastern Wisconsin.

shelters.name: Last Paw Rescue
shelters.description: All-volunteer, non-profit organization dedicated to rescue, rehabilitation and rehoming of displaced dogs.

shelters.name: Crossroads K9 Rescue
shelters.description: Volunteer driven non-profit dedicated to rescuing dogs left homeless, abandoned, or at high risk of euthanasia.

shelters.name: Door County Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving Door County on the Door Peninsula.

shelters.name: Kenosha Humane Society
shelters.description: Wisconsin Humane Society campus serving Kenosha County in southeastern Wisconsin.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Wisconsin animal shelters, humane societies, and rescue organizations. Wisconsin Humane Society (founded 1879) is largest in state, serving 40,000+ animals annually across 6 county campuses. Dane County Humane Society serves 9,000+ animals yearly. HAWS celebrating 60th anniversary. Coverage spans Milwaukee, Madison, Green Bay, Waukesha, and statewide.
